subject: Clarify AWS listing pricing footnotes + AMI usage for CloudOptics offer
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@cloudoptics.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudoptics.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing pricing footnotes + AMI question

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the draft listing — team reviewed it this morning. A couple of quick clarifying questions before we finalize:

1) Pricing footnotes: there are three footnotes referenced in the SKU table (A, B, C). Can you confirm which ones apply to pay-as-you-go vs. reserved? The procurement team needs explicit language for our PO.

2) AMI usage: our security team wants to confirm whether customers launching the AMI will transfer any data back to Redwood (telemetry/metrics). The listing currently says "usage metrics may be collected" — can you be more specific?

3) Marketplace visibility: we noticed the current hero copy emphasizes "low-latency inference" but our buyers also care about compliance (SOC 2). Could we tuck a compliance callout under the short description?

Attached a spreadsheet with what our Finance team needs for procurement mapping. Can you loop in the right folks on your side?

Best,
Alice
Alice Chen
Head of Cloud Partnerships
CloudOptics
[Attachment: pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice@cloudoptics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing pricing footnotes + AMI question

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear notes and the spreadsheet. Quick answers below and next steps: 

1) Pricing footnotes:
- Footnote A: applies to on-demand (pay-as-you-go) per-token tiers.
- Footnote B: applies only to 1-year reserved instances (applies when a customer purchases Reserved Capacity via Redwood Dedicated).
- Footnote C: is a callout for partner co-sell credits and is not applicable to standard SKUs.

Action: Ben, can you confirm the exact copy we should publish for each footnote so CloudOptics procurement can copy into the PO? I started a suggested 1-line below to speed this up.

2) AMI telemetry: 
- Short answer: the AMI does collect anonymous aggregated telemetry (agent version, instance type, region, basic health metrics) to help with automated support & compatibility checks. We do NOT collect customer data or request payloads.
- We will add a privacy/telemetry FAQ snippet to the listing and link to our security page.

3) Compliance callout: good catch. Marissa — can we add a 1-line SOC 2 mention under the short description (e.g., "SOC 2 Type II controls; enterprise customers can request audit summary").

Attachments: I took a pass on the listing text and attached a redline.

Next: Ben/Marissa, can you review the attached redline and the proposed footnote copy by EOD so I can send final text to Alice and her procurement team?

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_listing_copy.docx]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing pricing footnotes + AMI question

On Thu, Jul 15, 2027 at 08:04 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> 1) Pricing footnotes:
> - Footnote A: applies to on-demand (pay-as-you-go) per-token tiers.
> - Footnote B: applies only to 1-year reserved instances (applies when a customer purchases Reserved Capacity via Redwood Dedicated).
> - Footnote C: is a callout for partner co-sell credits and is not applicable to standard SKUs.

All: I drafted explicit one-liners below that are compliant with AWS Marketplace guidance — feel free to tweak: 

- Footnote A (On-demand): "On-demand rates apply per token generated and include runtime infrastructure charges; discounts do not apply to billed third-party integrations."
- Footnote B (Reserved): "Reserved Capacity rates reflect an annual commitment and require a separate reserved capacity subscription through the Redwood Dedicated offering."
- Footnote C (Co-sell credits): "Partner co-sell credits may be applied subject to partner program eligibility; contact your partner representative for details."

I also updated the SKU table to call out the billing unit (tokens/minute) and added a small cell explaining the refund window for AMI purchases (30 days).

Marissa: I left a short SOC 2 blurb in the short description (see redline). Laura — from GTM optics, do we want that blurb to live in the short description or the bullet list (search and hero visibility tradeoffs)?

-Ben

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ami-usage-diagram.png (image/png)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice@cloudoptics.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing pricing footnotes + AMI question

Hi Alice — appreciate the thorough review and the procurement template.

Quick answers and plan:
- We accept the procurement mapping in your spreadsheet. Rishi — please send the final one-liners for A/B/C and I'll sign off from GTM.
- On AMI telemetry: we will attach an explicit FAQ line in the listing and link to our security page. No customer payloads are collected.
- SOC 2 callout: let's surface a 1-line callout under the short description. That improves buyer confidence in Marketplace search results.

Alice, once we lock the language I'll also provide a one-page co-sell briefing (GTM bullets + target buyer personas) you can use for joint outreach.

Thanks — will finalize after Rishi/Ben post final copy.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
